observations_and_findings.classification: Existing 059 q641 candidate / 774 RIG-ADMISSION03-F049 corroborated at 95e; no new unique finding
observations_and_findings.mechanism: A public raw u16 wall gauge in a derived-Deserialize BreastplateDesign reaches profile validation first, then the AnimeDesign validator, whose otherwise-valid scalar conditions lead to gauge.0 * 2 at u16 width before the enclosing 1–20mm gauge predicate. Default profile and default Anime scalar values satisfy their earlier checks. Gauge 32768 or greater therefore overflows when overflow checks are enabled; wrapping behavior and later gauge rejection differ when checks are disabled. The selected authored-input loader calls serde_json then validate_breastplate; the selected device entry invokes the same validator.
observations_and_findings.conditions_and_limits: This is source and arithmetic reasoning, not an executed JSON, error path or product observation. A valid profile and earlier Anime fields are required to reach the multiplication. No retained invalid mesh, accepted malformed gauge or native runtime failure is claimed. q608 is a related pending revisit, not automatically a distinct finding or alias; exact global reconciliation and supported input policy remain central.
observations_and_findings.future_direction: Choose admission/checked-unit ownership so raw gauge rejects through the intended structured contract before unsafe doubling; preserve valid gauge/lift relations and deliberate error policy.

observations_and_findings.classification: Distinct conditional current producer-to-validation contract; current candidate, not accepted unique count
observations_and_findings.mechanism: For an otherwise-valid Solid breastplate with wall_thickness 4–20mm, warm_up clones the design and replaces construction with default Anime without changing gauge. The default 7mm lap lift fails 7 >= 2*gauge. For the selected cuirass, DedicatedGenerator routes to breastplate generation and the device entry validates the alternate; if all earlier stages and pre-validation device work succeed and that call is reached, BreastplateShape propagates from the alternate warm-up instead of a completed WarmupReport. This is a producer of a cross-field invalid state from a separately valid input, not the raw overflow first failure.
observations_and_findings.conditions_and_limits: The embedded default recipe is Solid with 2mm gauge, which does not trigger this relation. The inspected browser example and test source use that embedded recipe. The public warm_up API can receive another typed input, but an ordinary application caller supplying a valid 4–20mm Solid design and reaching this stage has not been demonstrated. Earlier body/device/catalog operations may fail first. No UI, device, geometry, browser, test, fixture or simulated design ran; no outcome is observed and no global alias inventory is claimed.
observations_and_findings.historical_relationship: Related in ownership to q641/F049 but distinct first contract, trigger and affected producer. Do not merge solely for a shared gauge/lift repair. Search of selected published and 059 queue found no named warm-up-gauge record; that bounded search is not a global uniqueness proof.
observations_and_findings.future_direction: Decide the warm-up input contract and whether alternate construction should derive an admissible lift or gauge while preserving intended source behavior. Trace supported non-embedded callers and actual preparation error owners before ledger closure.

observations_and_findings.classification: bounded prior evidence corroboration; no new finding
observations_and_findings.mechanism: HelmetDesign owns family payloads; HelmetKind selects default variants rather than constituting independently retained state on this scoped path. The general helmet recipe checks design.validate before parts; the parts dispatcher explicitly rejects CloseHelmet/MailCoif in favor of their separate paths. ArmingCap skips family shape constraints but still reaches the shared fit gate. Coif in the selected garment path validates and converts a typed cause to Debug text.
observations_and_findings.conditions_and_limits: Child crown, buffe, fluting and CloseHelmet implementation, native geometry, all other callers and supported error-consumer needs are not cleared by this body. Shared fit is computed before shape matching but is rejected only at the final conjunction, so no claim child validators are short-circuited by an invalid fit. Coif error conversion corroborates existing q2478 and prior garment packet, not a duplicate; q1813/q3141 and prior helmet topology/buffe assessment remain separate.

nonfindings: The editor transition to Anime clamps gauge to at most 6mm and raises lap lift to at least 2*gauge in the inspected body; do not apply the warm-up finding to that transition.
The shipped 2mm Solid breastplate fixture avoids the identified 7mm/2*gauge conflict; this does not validate its other geometry.
A Permille factor above 1000 is allowed for several explicit fit/reach controls; do not treat every such value as a probability.
No source evidence here proves optional crown absence for cap/coif or a Solid construction is invalid.

thirteen_lenses.producer-propagation: Raw authored breastplate -> loader/validator -> selected device path; alternate warm-up producer violates a cross-field admission condition only for stated gauges. Full supported caller inventory remains open.
thirteen_lenses.existing-type-owners: Millimeters, Permille, HelmetFit and typed DesignError are present; their raw values need semantic context rather than universal interval narrowing.
thirteen_lenses.admission-contracts: Anime scalars and gauge relation are checked but outer gauge gate follows multiplication; helmet family and shared fit checks are explicit. Public raw fields and derived Serde precede validation.
thirteen_lenses.invariant-operations: Gauge u16 doubling requires checked/admitted input; warm-up construction replacement can break the lift/gauge relation. No behavior was executed.
thirteen_lenses.aggregate-states: Anime lap lift and gauge are an aggregate contract. Warm-up cloning changes only construction, conditional invalidity follows mathematically.
thirteen_lenses.type-ownership: BreastplateConstruction and HelmetDesign own variant payload; selecting a semantic owner for admitted gauge versus aggregate validation remains unresolved.
thirteen_lenses.redundant-authority: HelmetKind is a catalog selector and HelmetDesign is a payload owner in the inspected bodies; no independent retained conflicting value was shown.
thirteen_lenses.type-granularity: Fit clearance, gauge, crown scaling and shape slopes have different roles even where they share scalar units; cannot infer that all Permille values must be <=1000.
thirteen_lenses.enum-shapes: Solid/Anime and helmet family variants own their payloads; optional coif/crown and fluting modes require their own existing policy.
thirteen_lenses.derivability: Serde and standard trait derives exist; exact user-facing wire compatibility, custom validation requirements and further derivation opportunities remain unassessed.
thirteen_lenses.magic-strings: The selected coif error formats Debug text, an existing q2478 trace; catalog keys and input file paths have boundary roles, not automatically duplicate semantic defects.
thirteen_lenses.magic-numbers: Source ranges, default 7mm lift and 4–20mm conditional gauge are explicitly tied to consumer contracts; no blanket physical range or replacement constants justified.
thirteen_lenses.behavior-preservation: Future design must preserve intended valid shape alternatives, gauge/lift semantics, optional modes and deliberate errors; neither repairs nor tests occurred.
